top.h1: Stitched to your measurement, not a size chart.
top.p: Blouse, salwar kameez, lehenga, kurti and alterations. Bring the cloth, we take the measurements, and you try it on before you pay the balance. Saree fall and pico done while you wait.
top.hero-note: Urgent blouse in 2 days for ₹200 extra. Trial fitting on every order, and fitting changes after the trial are free.

services.h2: Six things we do every week.
services.p: Stitching charge only. You bring the cloth, or pick from the lining, astar and canvas we keep in the shop.

photo.alt: A hand holding the hem of a red embroidered blouse piece among other fabrics

services.p2: Plain, princess cut, boat neck, back-open, padded. Katori and lining included. Bridal blouses with hand embroidery on request. Bring the saree too so the length and the back match.

photo2.alt: A woman seated in a floral printed salwar kameez with a dupatta

services.p3: Straight cut, A-line, Anarkali, with churidar, palazzo or straight pant. Dupatta edging done free with the suit. Lining added for thin fabrics.

photo3.alt: A young woman in a pink embroidered lehenga and dupatta

services.p4: Can-can, flared or A-line skirt with a matching blouse. We stitch the lehenga from your fabric and work, or alter a readymade one to fit. Book a month before the wedding.

photo4.alt: A woman seated in a blue printed kurta set with a light dupatta

services.p5: Office kurtis, long gowns for Pujo and reception, frocks and lehenga-choli for little girls. Ten pieces or more get a lower rate and a fixed date.

photo5.alt: Close-up of a sewing machine needle stitching a seam

services.p6: Blouse loosening or tightening, sleeve change, kurti length, pant fitting, zip or hook change. Readymade clothes too. Give it before 1 pm for same-day work.

photo6.alt: A woman's hands hand-stitching a blue fabric

services.p7: Fall stitched by hand, edges pico on the machine. Matching fall from our stock or yours. Bring the saree in the morning, take it back by evening.

prices.p: Stitching charges only. Cloth, lace, buttons and embroidery work are extra and we tell you the full amount before we cut. Prices from 1 January 2026. Days count from when we have your cloth and measurements.
prices.tabs-note: Half the amount is paid when you give the cloth, the rest at the trial. Before Durga Pujo (from mid-September) add 5 days to everything.
prices.price-note: Want something not on the list? Send a photo on WhatsApp and we will quote before you buy the cloth.

process.h2: From your first message to the finished garment.
process.p: Measurements are taken by Rupa or Shree in a closed trial room and written on a card we keep for you. You come to the shop twice: once to measure, once for the trial.
process.p2: Send a photo of the design on WhatsApp, or walk in. We tell you the stitching charge, how much cloth to buy and the delivery date before anything else.
process.p3: Fourteen measurements for a blouse, eighteen for a suit, more for a lehenga. If you brought an old blouse that fits, we copy what you like and fix what you do not. Half the amount is paid now.
process.p4: The masterji cuts from your card. Lining, astar and canvas go in from our stock. Nothing is cut until the design and price are agreed.
process.tl-when4: Blouse day 3 · suit day 5 · lehenga day 8 and 12
process.p5: Tacked, not finished, so anything can still change. Sleeve, neck depth, length, tightness. Changes at this stage are free. The balance is paid here.
process.tl-when5: Blouse day 5 · suit day 7 · lehenga day 15
process.p6: Hooks, piping, fall and pressing are done after the trial. Your garment hangs in the front room under your name till you collect. Fall-pico and small alterations are same day: give before 1 pm, collect after 6 pm.

photo.alt: A measuring tape and sewing pins on the cutting table

process.aside-foot: Repeat customers can skip the visit: we have your card, so just send the cloth with a reference blouse.

items.li: Your fabric. Blouse 80 cm to 1 m (1.2 m for long sleeves); salwar kameez 2.5 m top and 2.5 m bottom; lehenga 4 to 6 m.
The saree the blouse is for, so the length and back match.
One old garment that fits you well, if you have it.
A photo of the design on your phone, or pick from our book.
Any lace, buttons or dori you want used. We stock the rest.

photo.alt: Finished pink and gold embroidered lehengas hanging in a row

story.h2: One shop, two sisters, four machines.
story.p: Rupa Mondal started stitching blouses from her Behala flat in 1998. Her sister Shree joined in 2004 and the shop in Sahapur Colony opened the next year. Today there are four machines, one masterji for cutting, and two women who do only hand finishing: hooks, piping, fall and pico.
story.p2: We keep every customer's measurements on a card, so a repeat blouse needs only a phone call and the cloth. Most of our customers have been coming for ten years or more.

faq.h2: Things customers ask before their first order.

items.h3: Do I have to bring my own cloth?
items.p: For the main fabric, yes. We keep cotton lining, astar, canvas, cups, hooks and matching thread in the shop and add those to the bill at cost.

items.h3: Can you copy a blouse I already have?
items.p: Yes. Bring it along. We measure the blouse and you, and tell you if anything should change. Most repeat customers simply hand over the cloth and a reference blouse.

items.h3: Can I give measurements over WhatsApp?
items.p: For a repeat order, yes, we have your card. For a first order we ask you to come once; a blouse measured on the phone almost never fits right the first time.

items.h3: What if the fitting is not right?
items.p: That is what the trial is for. Fitting changes after the trial are free. If a finished garment does not fit because of our mistake, we fix it or stitch it again at no charge.
Yes, for school uniforms, office kurtis and wedding-party blouses. Ten pieces or more get a lower rate and a fixed date. Message us the count and the date.

items.h3: Do you take orders before Pujo?
items.p: Yes, but add 5 days to every delivery time from mid-September, and we stop taking new Pujo orders on Mahalaya. Book your Pujo blouses in August if you can.
I have had my blouses stitched here for twelve years. I give the cloth to Shree di on Monday and pick it up on Saturday. Never once a fitting problem.
They stitched my daughter's reception lehenga from fabric we bought in Gariahat. Two trials, every change done without a fuss, and ready a week before the date.
